newsitem.title: UK: Merrydown warns against performance decline.
newsitem.headline: Merrydown warns against performance decline.

text.p: British drinks manufacturer Merrydown Plc warned on Wednesday that its results for the year to March 31, 1997 would fall "significantly" below current market expectations.
Merrydown manufactures alcopops and it said one of its popular brands 'Two Dogs' had not lived up to expectations in its last quarter.
The company's share price was marked 15 1/2 pence lower at 75p as the warning was announced.

"Sales...were disappointing in the final quarter of 1996/97 as a result of the company's inability to maintain distribution in an increasingly competitive market place," it said in its trading statement.
The drinks maker, however, maintained positive progress in sales of its Merrydown ciders and Shloer brands.
It said it was taking "positive action" to focus on these core brands.
"The board is also implementing an aggressive cost cutting programme in order to reduce the fixed cost base of the business," it said.
The company is expected to announce its preliminary results on June 30.
